instruction: Set VLC's recording directory to the Desktop folder.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VLC Media > Open File dialog, navigated to Desktop, selected the Rick Astley mp4, and played it. Task completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with VLC menus, navigate file open dialog, browse directories, select and open media files, control playback
metadata.task_rationale: Tests VLC preferences navigation - agent must find and modify recording settings instead of playing media
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC Tools > Preferences and changing the recording directory to /home/user/Desktop. Uses existing is_vlc_recordings_folder metric which reads vlcrc config file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads the vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which is the right source for VLC recording directory settings.

Metric (is_vlc_recordings_folder) correctly parses the vlcrc file, skips comments, searches for 'input-record-path' key, and compares the extracted value against the expected path '/home/user/Desktop'.
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is semantically correct for the instruction 'Set VLC's recording directory to the Desktop folder'.
The expected parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns {'recording_file_path': '/home/user/Desktop'} and the metric accesses rule['recording_file_path'] directly.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (recording directory set to Desktop) is fully verified by the evaluator.
No postconfig needed since vlcrc is a persistent file on disk, not dependent on UI state.
